description_en: Queries the list of join permissions owned by the current user account based on a conditional query
description_zh: 根据过滤条件查询当前用户账号所拥有的入网凭证列表
kebab_example: aliyun linkwan list-owned-join-permissions --fuzzy-renter-aliyun-id some-user --fuzzy-join-eui d896e0 --enabled false --fuzzy-join-permission-name '凭证1' --offset 0 --limit 2 --sorting-field CREATED_MILLIS --ascending true --api-version 2018-12-30 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListOwnedJoinPermissions

parameters.help_en: The Alibaba Cloud account ID of the join permission tenant for fuzzy match
parameters.help_zh: 模糊匹配入网凭证租户的阿里云账号ID
parameters.name: fuzzy_renter_aliyun_id

parameters.help_en: The JoinEUI used by the join permission for fuzzy match
parameters.help_zh: 模糊匹配入网凭证所使用的JoinEUI
parameters.name: fuzzy_join_eui

parameters.help_en: Filters join permissions by their enabled or disabled status
parameters.help_zh: 根据入网凭证的启停用状态过滤
parameters.name: enabled

parameters.help_en: The name of the join permission for fuzzy match
parameters.help_zh: 模糊匹配入网凭证的名称
parameters.name: fuzzy_join_permission_name

parameters.help_en: The start position of this query, starting from 0
parameters.help_zh: 本次查询的起始位置，从 0 开始
parameters.name: offset

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of join permissions to return in this query. The value must be greater than or equal to 1
parameters.help_zh: 本次查询的入网凭证的数量上限，大于等于 1
parameters.name: limit

parameters.help_en: The sorting field. Set the value to CREATED_MILLIS to sort by creation time
parameters.help_zh: 指定排序字段，可取值为CREATED_MILLIS, 表示根据创建时间排序
parameters.name: sorting_field

parameters.help_en: Specifies the sort order. Used together with the SortingField parameter. A value of true indicates ascending order. A value of false indicates descending order
parameters.help_zh: 配合SortingField参数一起使用，true表示升序，false表示降序
parameters.name: ascending
